rule.description: LPE Quartet: unprivileged user namespace created (unshare/setns) [$(audit.exe)] - common precursor for DirtyAH6/TUNderflow/PPPoEject
CVE-2026-80844 (DirtyAH6): raw IPv6 socket (AF_INET6/SOCK_RAW) created [$(audit.exe)] - required to craft the malformed HDRINCL packet
CVE-2026-80844 (DirtyAH6): AF_NETLINK/NETLINK_XFRM socket created [$(audit.exe)] - used to program the IPsec/AH policy targeted by the exploit

CVE-2026-80844 (DirtyAH6) EXPLOIT CHAIN DETECTED: user namespace + raw IPv6 socket from the same login session [ses=$(audit.session) pid=$(audit.pid) exe=$(audit.exe)] - IMMEDIATE INVESTIGATION REQUIRED

CVE-2026-80844 (DirtyAH6): user namespace + NETLINK_XFRM socket from the same login session [ses=$(audit.session) pid=$(audit.pid) exe=$(audit.exe)] - possible IPsec/AH policy staging for exploitation
CVE-2026-81000 (TUNderflow): AF_NETLINK/NETLINK_ROUTE socket created [$(audit.exe)] - direct network device programming. Low level: also used by NetworkManager, systemd-networkd, ip and nmcli

CVE-2026-81000 (TUNderflow) EXPLOIT CHAIN DETECTED: user namespace + (/dev/net/tun access or NETLINK_ROUTE socket) from the same login session [ses=$(audit.session) pid=$(audit.pid) exe=$(audit.exe)] - IMMEDIATE INVESTIGATION REQUIRED
CVE-2026-74469 (DiagSpill): SCTP socket created [$(audit.exe)] - required condition, no special privilege needed
CVE-2026-74469 (DiagSpill): NETLINK_SOCK_DIAG query [$(audit.exe)] - may trigger the oversized sctp_diag dump. Low level: also generated by ss and socket monitoring tools
LPE Quartet: execution from /tmp or /dev/shm of a binary matching a public PoC name [$(audit.exe)]
LPE Quartet (root): user namespace created (unshare/setns) [$(audit.exe)] - precursor observed for DirtyAH6/TUNderflow/PPPoEject
LPE Quartet (root): raw IPv6 socket created [$(audit.exe)] - prerequisite observed for DirtyAH6 (CVE-2026-80844)
LPE Quartet (root): NETLINK_XFRM socket created [$(audit.exe)] - prerequisite observed for DirtyAH6 (CVE-2026-80844)
LPE Quartet (root): NETLINK_ROUTE socket created [$(audit.exe)] - prerequisite observed for TUNderflow (CVE-2026-81000)
LPE Quartet (root): SCTP socket created [$(audit.exe)] - prerequisite observed for DiagSpill (CVE-2026-74469)
LPE Quartet (root): NETLINK_SOCK_DIAG socket created [$(audit.exe)] - prerequisite observed for DiagSpill (CVE-2026-74469)
